TIÊU ĐỀ: Product Engineer Fresher/Junior
CÔNG TY: Flexspace Technologies Inc.
ĐỊA ĐIỂM: Quận khác, Hồ Chí Minh
MỨC LƯƠNG: Thỏa thuận
KỸ NĂNG: LLM Agents, Python, Go, TypeScript, Ruby, Next.js, Git / GitFlow, Embedded Systems

--- MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC ---
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us
Own critical product surfaces end‑to‑end
Build real revenue engines with AI and data
Hybrid, async work that respects working style
The Job
About Flexspace AI
• Flexspace AI is the e-commerce + AI revenue platform for coworking — / Shopify / Airbnb for flexible workspace. Seed-funded. We turn operators' websites into high-converting storefronts and run AI agents that price and market their inventory in real time.
• What we ship: mobile-first booking engine that embeds in any operator's site; SmartPricing Agent for dynamic pricing on meeting rooms, day passes, offices; SmartMarketing Agent for promo campaigns; operator dashboard for revenue/bookings/attribution; member portal for end customers; two-way integrations with prominent property management systems.
• Who buys it: coworking operators from single-location indies to multi-country brands. Their revenue is the conversion rate of the screens you'll design — CTAs, catalog, transitions, and checkout aren't decoration here; they're the product.
• How we work: small, agile, AI-heavy. On track to profitability this year. Headcount is deliberately small so each person owns real surface area — tight feedback loops, no bureaucracy, no committees. We measure shipped work — funnel lifts, partner themes shipped, UX issues triaged — not hours. No face-time theater.
• Co-located hybrid out of Workflow Thao Dien in HCMC for in-person speed. Wider team is async-first, written-first across US, Israel, Turkey, Philippines, and Vietnam. Weekly product/design sync with the CTO/cofounder — no layers between you and the people deciding what to build.
Role Overview
Product Engineer building the e-commerce platform behind the next generation of coworking spaces—SmartPricing, SmartMarketing, the booking engine operators embed on their sites, and the integrations that tie it all together. You work directly with the founders, with no layers between you and the people setting the roadmap. We also welcome final-year students looking for an internship.
• What engineering means here. The hard problem isn't writing code—AI writes plenty of it now. It's deciding what's worth building. Operators juggle hundreds of spaces, prices, members, bookings, and integrations across locations and time zones; customers comparing meeting rooms decide in seconds. Your job is to understand these humans—in the data—then ship software that moves their revenue. Empathy and data are the input; working product is the output. Polish comes last.
• On prioritization. Not all code has the same payoff. You'll look at a problem from several angles—funnel data, operator feedback, revenue, churn signals—and pick the work where your hours move the business most. A feature nobody uses is wasted hours; a 2% lift on the booking funnel is the company's quarter. Judgment over completeness.
• On decisions. Bigger calls go to the team before you build. Smaller calls—ship, watch the data, iterate. We're data-driven, not opinion-driven, and seniority doesn't win arguments—evidence does. You'll own the surfaces you touch, with support, and you expose your reasoning so we can calibrate together.
• On growth. You're early-career, and we hire for that on purpose. Expect code review, pairing, and direct coaching from founders and senior engineers. We can teach the stack, the patterns, and the product thinking. The one thing we can't give you is drive—that comes from you.
What You'll Do
• Ship features end-to-end. Work with founders and operators to understand a need, then spec, build, and release it—with support along the way.
• Build and evolve our SmartPricing & SmartMarketing agents. Pricing rules, targeting logic, and performance monitoring.
• Make booking effortless. Seamless booking experiences with instant payment, embedded right in operators' websites.
• Wire up integrations. Sync data with coworking CRMs, inventory systems, and analytics tools—and prevent double bookings.
• Pull data, form an opinion, decide. Revenue, Mixpanel, GA4 / GTM funnel data, and operator feedback.
• Write so the team stays in sync. Clear specs and pull-request descriptions that keep an async, distributed team aligned across time zones.
How You'll Work With AI
Claude as peers, not novelties. You'll write and refine structured prompts, build new ones, and ship real changes through AI tools. Senior engineers coach you and set guardrails so you can move fast without first becoming a framework expert. Judgment, taste, and clear thinking are the bottleneck now—not syntax. We give you a budget for the best AI tools because we expect you to use them as leverage, not as a crutch.
What Success Looks Like In Your First 6 Months
• You've shipped real features to production that operators and members actually use.
• You can navigate the codebase and pick up unfamiliar areas without much hand-holding.
• You ship changes through Claude with sound judgment about what to accept and what to rework.
• You back your decisions and pushback with data—and your written updates keep the async team moving without meetings.
• You're catching product, UX, and trade-off issues early, not just implementing tickets.
What Makes You a Great Fit
We prioritize these qualities top-down—technical skills can be learned quickly by sharp, curious people with low ego and a strong work ethic. Above all, here's what we look for:
• Drive and motivation. We can give you the tools, the environment, and hands-on coaching—but we can't give you the drive to succeed as a product engineer in the modern AI era. That has to come from you.
• Attention to detail and high standards. You're obsessed with quality—it's not about just getting the job done, it's about delivering the best work you can and raising the team's bar. You sweat the small things—edge cases, copy, data correctness—because details separate a working product from a trusted one.
• Clear written English. You read and write clear English (with the help with AI tools); in an async, globally distributed team, your writing is how you think, collaborate, and lead.
• High agency. You take initiative—ask questions when something's unclear, chase down answers, and push your work forward instead of waiting to be told the next step.
• You question everything. Everyone has a voice and is expected to push the envelope. There's no "the senior person knows better"—answers and pushback alike are grounded in data and critical thinking, regardless of title or age.
• Curiosity and fast learning. You pick up new domains, tools, and concepts quickly, especially around AI, pricing, and B2B SaaS.
• Product sense. You care about customers and business context, not just the tech stack, and you treat engineering as a way to drive revenue, bookings, and occupancy. You grasp basic microeconomics—incentives, opportunity cost, supply and demand—as a toolkit for trade-offs: simpler designs that still maximize value, arguments made in terms of impact rather than opinion, and an understanding of why the business prioritizes what it does. Don't have this thinking framework yet? If you bring the motivation, we'll coach you on it.
Your Skills and Experience
Must-have
• Vietnamese, based in Ho Chi Minh City. Hired on a Vietnamese employment contract. No visa sponsorship or relocation funding.
• Solid CS fundamentals. You understand how data is structured, how APIs work, and how to troubleshoot methodically—and you can name what you're doing and why.
• Comfortable with the basics that make a good teammate. Git, reading existing code, writing tests, and jumping into unfamiliar parts of a codebase.
• Some Ruby, TypeScript, or Python. You'll spend most of your time in Ruby and TypeScript. We don't expect all three—we expect you to learn fast.
• A project we can look at. At least one thing you built that works—side project, open source, internship, hackathon, or coursework—with a link and a clear story of how and why you built it.
• AI-native. You use Claude and Cursor daily and know where they shine and where they break down.
• Writing and reading English for async work. Speaking can be conversational—we coach.
• Agency. You spot things, fix things, ship things—you don't wait to be told.
Self-taught software engineers are welcome. You don't have to study IT or computer majors to become a good software product builders. What matters is the drive, agency, attention to detail, willingness to ship, and how fast you learn. If you read this and thought "I could do that with some support," don't self-select out—apply.
Why You'll Love Working Here
This role suits future founders. Direct cofounder access, real ownership of decisions and outcomes, scope across an entire product surface, an inside look at how a small team turns AI into shipped product. If you aspire to build your own startup product one day, this is the seat that builds the muscles.
Compensation & growth
• Salary: up to 26M VND/month GROSS. Calibrated on portfolio strength, interview sharpness, and demonstrated speed of learning, not years on a resume. Exceptional candidates can be discussed above this band.
• Comp reviews on request — if you've grown the role, raise it.
• Probation: 2 months at full salary. Passes on shipping consistently — no surprise gates.
• Stock options eligibility and a company laptop after probation. Bring your own laptop during probation.
Tools
• Company-paid Claude
Workspace & culture
• Covered desk at Workflow Thao Dien (HCMC). Hybrid at least 2 days/week in-person. Flexible hours.
• Vietnam time (ICT). Occasional pre-scheduled evening calls overseas, rare in practice.
• English-first, American startup culture: direct feedback, written-first, low-meeting. We measure shipped work, not hours.
Benefits
• BHXH / BHYT / BHTN contributions per Vietnamese labor law.
• Vietnamese public holidays off (incl. Tết).
• Unlimited personal time off. Coordinate with the team based on urgency and your ownership.
Hiring process
Three real-time conversations with humans. No automated screening, no pre-recorded video tasks, no take-home gauntlet.
• Intro call — short conversation to get a sense of your English and how clearly you articulate your thinking.
• Team conversation — in person at Workflow Thao Dien. Walk us through your portfolio, talk shop, hang out, code together, grab lunch (we pay).
• Conversation with the CTO — remote (or in-person if on business trip). Product, technical fluency, working style.

• Thiết kế các 2D game assets như UI, icon, button, popup, banner, background và các thành phần đồ họa trong game.

Giới tính / Độ tuổi / Ngoại hình / Sức khỏe

  • Giới tính: Nam/Nữ 
  • Độ tuổi: Từ 25 tuổi trở lên 
  • Ngoại hình: tác phong chuyên nghiệp. 

Yêu cầu Bằng cấp: Tốt nghiệp Cao đẳng trở lên, ưu tiên Đại học( Công Nghệ Thông Tin, Kỹ Thuật Phần Mềm)

Trình độ ngoại ngữ / tin học: Đọc hiểu tài liệu chuyên ngành tốt (Tiếng Anh là một lợi thế lớn để cập nhật công nghệ mới).

Số năm kinh nghiệm làm việc: Tối thiểu 01- 02 năm kinh nghiệm làm việc tại vị trí tương đương

Yêu cầu chuyên môn công việc: Kinh nghiệm: Tối thiểu 1-2 năm kinh nghiệm làm việc ở vị trí QC/Tester (Chấp nhận các bạn Fresher có tư duy tốt và nền tảng CNTT vững chắc).

Kỹ năng Kiểm thử:

  • Thành thạo quy trình kiểm thử phần mềm (Manual Test): Từ việc viết Test Case, thực thi kiểm thử đến quản lý lỗi (Bug life cycle).
  • Có khả năng kiểm thử trên nhiều nền tảng: Mobile App (iOS/Android) và Web Responsive.
  • Biết sử dụng công cụ kiểm tra API như Postman (để kiểm tra logic dữ liệu trả về từ Backend).
  • Quản lý lỗi: Sử dụng thành thạo các công cụ quản lý dự án và lỗi như Jira, Trello, hoặc Redmine.
  • Kiến thức bổ trợ: Ưu tiên ứng viên có kiến thức cơ bản về SQL để truy vấn kiểm tra dữ liệu trong Database.

Kỹ năng mềm & Tư duy (Soft Skills & Mindset)

  • Sự tỉ mỉ và Cẩn trọng (Meticulousness): Đây là yêu cầu tiên quyết. Bạn phải có khả năng ngồi so sánh từng con số, từng tên sao, từng cung mệnh giữa App và tài liệu chuyên gia mà không sai sót.
  • Tư duy Phân tích (Analytical Thinking): Có khả năng đặt ra các kịch bản kiểm thử "ngặt nghèo" (Boundary cases) để tìm ra các lỗi logic tiềm ẩn.
  • Kỹ năng Giao tiếp: Có khả năng mô tả lỗi một cách rõ ràng, mạch lạc (kèm hình ảnh/video) để lập trình viên có thể tái hiện và sửa lỗi nhanh nhất.
  • Kiên nhẫn: Sẵn sàng thực hiện kiểm thử lặp đi lặp lại (Regression Test) để đảm bảo chất lượng ổn định nhất sau mỗi bản cập nhật.

Điểm cộng (Nice to have)

  • Có hiểu biết hoặc yêu thích tìm hiểu về phong thủy, lịch âm dương, tử vi (giúp hiểu nghiệp vụ nhanh hơn).
  • Biết sử dụng các công cụ kiểm thử tự động (Automation Test) cơ bản hoặc kiểm thử hiệu năng (Load Test).
  • Có kinh nghiệm kiểm thử các ứng dụng có sử dụng cảm biến (La bàn, GPS).

The Job

The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the smooth functioning of our software applications by providing timely support to our clients and resolving technical issues as efficiently as possible. They will work closely with Level 1 support to ensure timely resolution of tickets and will escalate complex issues to the Level 3 support team. The candidate should be adept at troubleshooting and have a strong understanding of various software development technologies. Ensure prompt and efficient resolution of technical issues related to the application throughout 24 hours a day, 7 days a week

• Data ETL pipelines
• Background jobs/services
• APM, Logging
• etc

• Collaborate closely with the Level 3 support team to escalate complex technical issues that require further analysis and investigation.
• Maintain thorough documentation of support activities, including issue resolution processes, for future reference and knowledge sharing.
• Communicate effectively with clients, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to provide timely updates on issue resolution and product performance, especially during 24/7.
• Proactively identify opportunities for process improvement and contribute to the enhancement of support services and system performance during 24/7.
Your Skills and Experience
• Proven experience in providing application support at Level 2 in an IT software development environment.
• Strong understanding of software development lifecycle and methodologies.
• Proficiency in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues related to software applications and systems.
• Knowledge of the technology stack (e.g. .NET Core, Ionic, NodeJS, Angular) to support issue analysis.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.

• Good English communication skills

Được đào đạo kĩ năng mềm và nghiệp vụ chuyên sâu The Job Chương trình dành cho các ứng viên trẻ yêu thích dữ liệu và công nghệ, mong muốn phát triển chuyên sâu trong lĩnh vực Data Engineering tại TPBank. • Tham gia xây dựng, phát triển và vận hành các luồng thu thập, xử lý và tích hợp dữ liệu. • Hỗ trợ thiết kế các quy trình ETL/ELT phục vụ báo cáo, phân tích và các hệ thống dữ liệu của Ngân hàng. • Làm việc với cơ sở dữ liệu, kho dữ liệu và các nền tảng xử lý dữ liệu lớn. • Theo dõi chất lượng dữ liệu; hỗ trợ phát hiện và xử lý các vấn đề phát sinh trong quá trình vận hành. • Tham gia tối ưu hiệu suất, tính ổn định và khả năng mở rộng của hệ thống dữ liệu. • Phối hợp với Data Analyst, Data Scientist và các đơn vị công nghệ để đáp ứng nhu cầu khai thác dữ liệu. • Tham gia các chương trình đào tạo, dự án thực tế và hoạt động phát triển năng lực dành cho Fresh DE. Your Skills and Experience • Thời gian tham gia chương trình: Toàn thời gian • Sinh viên năm cuối hoặc đã tốt nghiệp các ngành Công nghệ thông tin, Khoa học máy tính, Hệ thống thông tin, Khoa học dữ liệu hoặc ngành liên quan. • Có kiến thức nền tảng về cơ sở dữ liệu và sử dụng được SQL. • Biết một ngôn ngữ lập trình như Python, Java hoặc Scala là lợi thế. • Có hiểu biết cơ bản về ETL/ELT, Data Warehouse, Data Lake hoặc các hệ thống xử lý dữ liệu. • Ưu tiên ứng viên đã tiếp cận các công nghệ như Spark, Kafka, Airflow, Hadoop, Cloud hoặc công cụ tương đương. • Có tư duy logic, khả năng phân tích và tinh thần chủ động giải quyết vấn đề. • Ham học hỏi, kiên trì, có trách nhiệm và mong muốn phát triển lâu dài trong lĩnh vực Data Engineering. Why You'll Love Working Here Thực hiện hoài bão xây dựng một ngân hàng tiên phong cho người Việt, TPBank mong muốn kết hợp sự thân thiện vốn có của người Việt Nam, tính chuyên nghiệp mang tầm quốc tế và Công nghệ cao để tạo nên nền tảng một ngân hàng hàng đầu tại Việt Nam. Tương lai nghề nghiệp vững chắc; các lãnh đạo nhiệt huyết và giàu kinh nghiệm; đồng nghiệp chia sẻ, cởi mở và thân thiện; môi trường làm việc hiện đại, chuyên nghiệp… và đặc biệt là chính sách nhân sự chuyên nghiệp với các chế độ đãi ngộ tài chính và phi tài chính mang tính toàn diện và hấp dẫn là những điều TPBank mong muốn mang đến cho toàn cán bộ nhân viên. CHÍNH SÁCH NHÂN SỰ: • Được đào tạo và phát triển sự nghiệp trong môi trường công nghệ tiên tiến, chuyên nghiệp, Ngân hàng Số hàng đầu tại Việt Nam. • Thu nhập hấp dẫn, lộ trình phát triển sự nghiệp bền vững. • TPBank duy trì một chính sách lương, thưởng cạnh tranh, cùng với các cơ hội thăng tiến trong nghề nghiệp, luôn minh bạch và công bằng nhất. • Bên cạnh chính sách đãi ngộ về tài chính, TPBank còn có các gói phúc lợi và đãi ngộ phi tài chính hiệu quả đảm bảo cho cán bộ nhân viên sức khỏe, hạnh phúc và một tương lai tài chính ổn định lâu dài. CHẾ ĐỘ ĐÃI NGỘ TÀI CHÍNH: Chính sách đãi ngộ dành cho Cán bộ nhân viên (CBNV) chính thức của TPBank gồm có: • Lương • Phụ cấp: Phụ cấp trang điểm (dành cho CBNV nữ), Phụ cấp ăn trưa, Phụ cấp xăng xe/đi lại, Phụ cấp điện thoại, Phụ cấp độc hại. • Chế độ phúc lơi: TPBank tặng quà hoặc tiền mặt cho CBNV nhân ngày lễ, tết: Ngày Quốc tế lao động, ngày Quốc Khánh, Tết Nguyên đán, Tết Dương lịch, Ngày Quốc tế Phụ nữ, Ngày phụ nữ Việt Nam, Ngày thành lập ngân hàng, ngày sinh nhật CBNV; Tết trung thu/Ngày Quốc tế Thiếu nhi (dành cho con CBNV)... • Lương kinh doanh: là phần thưởng trên phần hiệu quả cho nhóm nhân viên trực tiếp kinh doanh theo chỉ tiêu được giao hàng tháng hoặc quý. • Thưởng hiệu quả hàng năm: TPBank trả thưởng hàng năm cho CBNV theo kết quả kinh doanh của ngân hàng và đánh giá hiệu quả làm việc của CBNV. CHẾ ĐỘ ĐÃI NGỘ PHI TÀI CHÍNH: Chính sách đãi ngộ phi tài chính dành cho cán bộ nhân viên (CBNV) chính thức của TPBank như sau: • Chương trình chăm sóc sức khỏe định kỳ và đặc biệt (AON Care); • Chương trình nghỉ mát hàng năm. • Chế độ nghỉ phép: 12 ngày, 14 ngày, 16 ngày hoặc 18 ngày tùy từng cấp CBNV. Ngoài ra, tại TPBank, các tổ chức Công đoàn, Đoàn thanh niên, Nhóm hoạt động tình nguyện Hearts in Hand, và các nhóm thành viên khác được tổ chức và hoạt động thường xuyên. Các chương trình sinh hoạt đoàn thể được tổ chức ngoài giờ làm việc góp phần tạo nên không khí vui tươi, thân thiện, sẻ chia cho cán bộ nhân viên TPBank. • Đặc biệt, các chương trình hoạt động cộng đồng mang tính nhân đạo xã hội cũng thường xuyên được tổ chức và nhận được sự hưởng ứng nhiệt tình của cán bộ nhân viên TPBank. Tại TPBank, "Mỗi nhân viên là một tài sản quý giá". TPBank luôn chào đón các bạn ứng viên, những người muốn đến với chúng tôi bằng tài năng, trí tuệ, phẩm chất đạo đức và lòng say mê công việc. Đến với TPBank, chúng tôi sẽ tạo cho bạn những cơ hội và thử thách để bạn tự khẳng định mình bằng chính tài năng của bạn. Bởi lẽ, Vì chúng tôi hiểu bạn. --- THÔNG TIN KHÁC --- Nguồn: ITviec | Cấp bậc: Fresher, Intern | Exp:

--- MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC ---
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us
MacBook Pro/Extra screens & Remote Work policy
Premium health insurance package for you, relative
Company Trip 4-5*, Yoga, Gym/Fitness/English club
The Job
🎯 Position Summary
• Are you a natural storyteller who loves creating content that resonates with real audiences? Are you also curious about how AI can help you work faster and think bigger? We're looking for a creative, detail-oriented individual to join our team as an AI Research & Content Generator — a content-first role where AI tools are your everyday assistant, not the main focus.
• In this role, you will plan and produce a wide variety of content for Athena's games and brand — from social media posts, short videos, marketing copy, and community content to blog articles and in-game text. You'll use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, and CapCut AI to speed up ideation, drafting, and production, while your own creative judgment, writing skills, and understanding of our audience remain the heart of every piece you ship. If you love writing, storytelling, and gaming culture — and see AI as a superpower rather than a subject — we want to hear from you.
🧠 Key Responsibilities
• Content Creation & Storytelling: Write, produce, and refine content across multiple formats — social media posts (Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Discord), marketing copy, blog articles, community announcements, store-listing content, and in-game text — that reflects Athena's tone and connects with our players.
• Brand Voice & Editorial Judgment: Ensure every piece of content sounds like Athena — consistent, engaging, and audience-appropriate. Make the final call on what's good enough to publish and what needs another pass.
• AI-Assisted Production: Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, CapCut AI, ElevenLabs, etc.) as your everyday assistant to speed up brainstorming, drafting, image mockups, video editing, and translation — always with a human eye on the final output.
• Content Planning: Contribute to the content calendar, propose ideas tied to game launches, events, community moments, and pop-culture trends. Turn briefs from Marketing and Game teams into ready-to-publish assets on time.
• Audience & Trend Research: Stay close to our players and the wider gaming community. Track what's resonating on social, in Discord — and translate those insights into better content.
• Light Performance Tracking: Review basic metrics (views, engagement, shares, comments) to understand what works and what doesn't. Use those learnings to improve the next round of content.
• Team Collaboration: Work closely with Marketing, Community, Art, and Game Design teams. Take direction, share drafts early, incorporate feedback quickly, and keep everyone in the loop.
Your Skills and Experience
• Strong Writing Skills: Excellent writing in Vietnamese (native-level) and English (Upper-Intermediate or higher). You can shift tone between engaging store-listing content based on given keywords (including App Name/Title, Description, and Visual Assets, etc.), playful social captions, professional press releases, and heartfelt community messages.
• Storytelling Instinct: A natural sense for what makes a story, a post, or a video actually engaging — not just informative. You've probably been writing, posting, or creating in some form for a while, even if just for fun.
• Content Portfolio: A portfolio is nice to have, but professional experience is not. Please share any content you've made — blog posts, social accounts you run, fanfiction, short videos, gaming reviews, Facebook Pages, TikToks, community posts, etc. We care about your voice and creativity more than your job title.
• Basic AI Tool Familiarity: Comfortable using at least 2–3 mainstream AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, CapCut AI) as part of your daily workflow. You don't need to be a prompt engineer — just curious, self-taught, and willing to keep learning.
• Love for Games & Pop Culture: A genuine interest in mobile, PC, or console games and the culture around them. You understand player language, memes, community dynamics, and what makes gamers care.
• Attention to Detail: Care about spelling, grammar, tone, and visual polish. You proofread before you publish.
• Eagerness to Learn: Open to feedback, quick to iterate, and excited to grow into a stronger content creator over time.
• Good Communication: Clear, friendly communication in English and/or Vietnamese within a team setting.
Preferred Qualifications (Bonus Points)
• Prior experience managing a social media account, Facebook Page, TikTok channel, YouTube channel, or Discord community (even personal ones count).
• Basic knowledge of SEO/ASO, social media best practices, or content performance metrics.
• Basic design or video editing skills (Canva, Photoshop, CapCut, Premiere).
• Familiarity with the gaming industry or streaming culture is a plus.
• Prior content, copywriting, community, or marketing experience — internship or freelance is welcome.
• Active presence in online communities (gaming forums, Discord servers, fandoms, creator platforms).
Why You'll Love Working Here
• Gain hands-on experience with AI tools.
• Receive mentorship from industry-leading experts.
• Enjoy flexible working hours tailored to your schedule.
• Opportunity for a full-time role based on performance.

raw job:
TIÊU ĐỀ: [PSC] Business Analyst / Chuyên viên Phân tích Nghiệp vụ
CÔNG TY: Công Ty Cổ Phần Phúc Sinh
ĐỊA ĐIỂM: Hồ Chí Minh, Quận 1
MỨC LƯƠNG: Thương lượng

--- MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC ---
Role Overview
We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our IT team, acting as the bridge between business Users and the IT department. You will work closely with Users across Phuc Sinh Corporation and its subsidiaries to understand their needs, translate them into clear requirements, and support the IT team (Developers and Infrastructure) in delivering effective solutions — particularly around our in-house ERP system.
Key Responsibilities
Requirements Gathering & Analysis
- Work directly with Users across departments and subsidiaries to understand business needs and pain points.
- Gather, document, and analyze business requirements for new features, system enhancements, and process improvements.
- Translate business requirements into clear specifications for the Development team.
Project & Stakeholder Coordination
- Act as the primary liaison between Users and the IT department throughout project delivery.
- Support project planning, track progress, and coordinate timelines with Developers and the Infrastructure team.
- Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations between business Users and IT.
Testing & Support
- Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure solutions meet business requirements before deployment.
- Prepare user guides and training materials, and support Users in adopting new systems and features.
- Provide first-level support to Users, escalating technical issues to the Development or Infrastructure team as needed.
Continuous Improvement
- Identify opportunities to improve business processes through better use of the ERP system and other tools.
- Monitor system usage and gather User feedback to inform future development priorities.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Tổng quan vị trí
Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm một Chuyên viên Phân tích nghiệp vụ (Business Analyst) gia nhập đội ngũ CNTT, đóng vai trò cầu nối giữa người dùng nghiệp vụ (User) và bộ phận CNTT. Bạn sẽ làm việc trực tiếp với User tại Tập đoàn Phúc Sinh và các công ty thành viên để hiểu nhu cầu của họ, chuyển hóa thành yêu cầu rõ ràng, và hỗ trợ đội ngũ CNTT (Lập trình viên và bộ phận Hạ tầng) triển khai các giải pháp hiệu quả — đặc biệt liên quan đến hệ thống ERP nội bộ.
Mô tả công việc
Thu thập và phân tích yêu cầu
- Làm việc trực tiếp với User tại các phòng ban và công ty thành viên để nắm bắt nhu cầu và các vấn đề nghiệp vụ.
- Thu thập, ghi nhận và phân tích yêu cầu kinh doanh cho các tính năng mới, cải tiến hệ thống và quy trình.
- Chuyển hóa yêu cầu kinh doanh thành đặc tả rõ ràng cho đội ngũ Lập trình viên.
Điều phối dự án và các bên liên quan
- Là đầu mối liên lạc chính giữa User và bộ phận CNTT trong suốt quá trình triển khai dự án.
- Hỗ trợ lập kế hoạch dự án, theo dõi tiến độ và phối hợp thời gian với Lập trình viên và bộ phận Hạ tầng.
- Tổ chức các cuộc họp, thu thập phản hồi và quản lý kỳ vọng giữa User và bộ phận CNTT.
Kiểm thử và hỗ trợ
- Hỗ trợ kiểm thử chấp nhận người dùng (UAT) để đảm bảo giải pháp đáp ứng đúng yêu cầu kinh doanh trước khi triển khai.
- Chuẩn bị tài liệu hướng dẫn sử dụng, tài liệu đào tạo và hỗ trợ User làm quen với hệ thống, tính năng mới.
- Hỗ trợ xử lý các vấn đề của User ở cấp độ đầu tiên, chuyển các vấn đề kỹ thuật cho đội Lập trình hoặc Hạ tầng khi cần.
Cải tiến liên tục
- Xác định các cơ hội cải tiến quy trình kinh doanh thông qua việc sử dụng hiệu quả hơn hệ thống ERP và các công cụ khác.
- Theo dõi việc sử dụng hệ thống và thu thập phản hồi của User để định hướng ưu tiên phát triển trong tương lai.
What We're Looking For
Qualifications
·       Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related fields.
·       At least 2–3 years of experience as a Business Analyst, IT Business Analyst, or in a similar role.
·       Ability to analyze business processes, gather user requirements, and translate business needs into clear documents for technical teams.
·       Experience in preparing business and functional documents such as BRD, User Stories, Use Cases, Flowcharts, Mockups/Wireframes, or functional specifications.
·       Good communication skills, with the ability to listen, ask the right questions, and work effectively with users from different departments, business units, or companies.
·       Collaborate with development, testing, and implementation teams to clarify requirements, support testing, UAT, acceptance, and product improvement.
·       Participate in system implementation, end-user training, and post-implementation support.
·       Experience in building or implementing ERP modules such as Purchasing, Sales, Inventory/Warehouse, Accounting, Human Resources, Manufacturing, or other enterprise management modules is a strong advantage.
·       Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and applying AI tools in daily work is preferred.
·       Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience with tools such as Visio, Draw.io, Figma, Balsamiq, Jira, Confluence, or equivalent tools is an advantage.
·       Strong system thinking, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills; proactive, detail-oriented, responsible, and able to follow tasks through to completion.
·       Good English skills, with the ability to read technical documents and work with system-related documents in English.[THD1]

--- MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC ---
1 - Mục đích công việc
Thực tập sinh (TTS) Hoạch định Chất lượng Công nghệ (QE) tham gia các hoạt động kiểm thử và đảm bảo chất lượng phần mềm dưới sự hướng dẫn của mentor và đội ngũ Quality Engineering (QE) của TCB. Vị trí giúp thực tập sinh phát triển nền tảng xuyên suốt vòng đời kiểm thử: tìm hiểu yêu cầu; thiết kế và thực thi kiểm thử; quản lý lỗi, bằng chứng kiểm thử và truy vết; đồng thời làm quen với kiểm thử API, dữ liệu, SQL, Git và tự động hóa kiểm thử.
Chương trình hướng đến đào tạo qua công việc thực tế, đóng góp vào các hạng mục kiểm thử phù hợp và xây dựng nguồn ứng viên tiềm năng cho vị trí Hoạch định Chất lượng Công nghệ - Chuyên viên (QE Officer). Thực tập sinh đạt tiêu chí đánh giá sau tối thiểu 6 tháng có thể được xem xét cho cơ hội tuyển dụng chính thức theo nhu cầu nhân sự và quy trình phê duyệt hiện hành.
2 - Trách nhiệm chính (1.1)
Thực thi kỹ thuật kiểm thử, đảm bảo chất lượng (dưới sự hướng dẫn của mentor)
1. Tìm hiểu yêu cầu, user story, tiêu chí chấp nhận, tài liệu thiết kế và kết quả unit test có liên quan để xác định điều kiện kiểm thử theo hướng dẫn.
2. Tạo thiết kế kiểm thử, kịch bản, trường hợp kiểm thử, script, dữ liệu, công cụ, thiết bị và môi trường.
3. Thực hiện các kiểm thử được phân công (như smoke test, sanity test, functional test, integration test và regression test hoặc API test); lưu giữ bằng chứng kiểm thử đầy đủ, chính xác và có thể truy vết.
4. Ghi nhận lỗi với thông tin tái hiện, mức độ ảnh hưởng, bằng chứng và dữ liệu liên quan; theo dõi, retest và cập nhật kết quả đến khi đóng lỗi theo quy trình.
5. Biết cách làm test report (dưới sự hướng dẫn của mentor)
3 - Trách nhiệm chính (1.2)
Thực thi kỹ thuật kiểm thử tự động (dưới sự hướng dẫn của mentor)
1. Làm quen, thực hành theo hướng dẫn với tối thiểu một mảng automation phù hợp của đội (ví dụ: API automation hoặc UI automation); đọc hiểu, chạy, cập nhật các script đơn giản khi được giao.
2. Sử dụng Git và các công cụ quản lý công việc/lỗi theo quy định; tiếp thu phản hồi từ người review, báo cáo kiểm thử và báo cáo lỗi để cải thiện chất lượng của automation script.
4 - Trách nhiệm chính (2)
Yêu cầu và phối hợp nghiệp vụ
1. Làm rõ yêu cầu nghiệp vụ và hệ thống với BA, lập trình viên (DE) và thành viên QE trong dự án được phân công.
2. Liên kết yêu cầu với điều kiện kiểm thử và duy trì truy vết yêu cầu - kiểm thử. Phối hợp với DE trong việc xác nhận lỗi, chuẩn bị dữ liệu/môi trường và kiểm tra lại bản sửa lỗi.
3. Hỗ trợ UAT và PAT khi được phân công (dưới sự giám sát của người chịu trách nhiệm)
4. Trao đổi kết quả kiểm thử và rủi ro chất lượng với các bên liên quan (có sự hướng dẫn và giám sát của người chịu trách nhiệm)
5 - Trách nhiệm chính (3)
Chất lượng, rủi ro và phát triển năng lực
1. Tuân thủ quy trình kỹ thuật chất lượng, kiểm soát an ninh và yêu cầu tuân thủ.
2. Kịp thời nhận diện và báo cáo rủi ro về chất lượng, tiến độ và tuân thủ.
3. Duy trì tài sản kiểm thử chính xác, tái sử dụng được và cập nhật.

Avery Dennison Corporation (NYSE: AVY) is a global materials science and digital identification solutions company. Our reported sales in 2025 were $8.9 billion. Learn more at www.averydennison.com.
ABOUT YOUR ROLE
* Production Technician/Technologist acts as a contact point between the production team and other departments like Prepress,
* Sample development, planning, etc... This position will be in charge of all technical related matters such as machine specifications, sample specifications, etc...
* Consult and support other departments with production technical issues and may participate in some new product development projects
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE
* Manage projects for new item development.
* Follow and review Samples / First Order Deployment (FOD) / Sampling processes.
* Work with other departments to define manufacturing specifications and requirements of new samples/products.
* Resolve issue relating to sample in design and production
* Confirm new samples have meet all requirements for mass productions
* Help other departments with technical related matters.
* May train and guide new staffs, operators
* May join (or lead) some projects to improve or develop new processes, products.
* 1 to 2 years experience in similar positions
* Knowledgeable of production, process control, sample development processes
* Well organized individual with an ability to handle multiple deadline driven projects
simultaneously.
* Experienced in managing printing orders, sample orders is a plus

Top 3 Reasons To Join Us

Annual allowances for personal development & sport
20 days annual leave & 5 days sick leave
The Job
The Role
• GeoComply is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Staff Mobile Engineer to join our team in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. In this role, you will be instrumental in shaping the mobile architecture of our geolocation compliance solutions, leading the technical direction for our iOS and Android SDKs while ensuring seamless integration with our core service.
• Our product relies on the robust operation of our mobile SDKs with our core geolocation engine. We have strong mobile engineers on both platforms, and we need your expertise to help design and implement the data flow, establish architectural patterns, and drive best practices to ensure our mobile solutions deliver exceptional performance and reliability.
• You will collaborate closely with engineering managers, product managers, and senior mobile engineers across iOS and Android, providing technical leadership and contributing to our product strategy. Your ability to think strategically, communicate effectively, and build consensus will be critical to your success.
Key Responsibilities
Mobile Architectural Leadership:
• Lead the design and architecture of mobile solutions across iOS and Android platforms, with a focus on the interactions between our SDKs and the core geolocation engine
• Define and document architectural patterns, interface specifications, and data flow strategies to ensure consistency, maintainability, and performance across both mobile platforms
• Ensure our mobile SDKs remain current with evolving mobile technologies, platform capabilities, and industry best practices
• Drive adoption of modern mobile development standards and emerging technologies to maintain technical excellence and competitive advantage
Cross-Platform Mobile Collaboration:
• Collaborate with senior engineers on iOS and Android to ensure adherence to the overall mobile architectural vision and promote the adoption of best practices
• Facilitate communication and alignment between iOS and Android development teams, fostering a collaborative environment
• Identify and address cross-cutting technical challenges between iOS and Android SDKs and the core engine
• Champion code sharing and architectural consistency across mobile platforms
Technical Guidance and Mentorship:
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to senior mobile engineers on architectural best practices and platform-specific considerations
• Participate in design and code reviews across mobile teams, offering constructive feedback and ensuring alignment with architectural standards
• Drive the adoption of modern mobile development practices and patterns
Product Development and Innovation:
• Work with Product Managers to understand product requirements and translate them into scalable and robust mobile technical solutions
• Research and evaluate new mobile technologies, frameworks, and methodologies to enhance our mobile architecture and improve development efficiency
• Contribute to the development and maintenance of shared mobile libraries, tools, and processes that streamline cross-platform mobile development
Quality and Delivery:
• Ensure that mobile solutions meet high standards for quality, performance, security, and scalability
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of our agile development processes
• Drive mobile-specific testing strategies including device testing, performance profiling, and anti-fraud detection validation
Customer Integration Design:
• Design and document clear, efficient, and user-friendly integration flows for customers to integrate our mobile SDKs into their applications, ensuring a smooth and positive developer experience
• Create comprehensive mobile SDK documentation and integration guides
Your Skills and Experience
Extensive Mobile Development Experience: 10+ years of professional software development experience with strong focus on mobile platforms (iOS and/or Android)
Deep Mobile Expertise:
• Strong experience in iOS development (Swift, Objective-C, iOS frameworks, Apple platform guidelines)
• Strong experience in Android development (Kotlin, Java, Android SDK, Google Play policies)
• Deep understanding of mobile-specific challenges: device fragmentation, OS version compatibility, background execution, battery optimization, network handling
• Experience with mobile security, anti-fraud techniques, and device attestation
Mobile Architectural Vision: Proven ability to design and implement complex mobile architectures spanning iOS and Android, with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and performance
Software Design Proficiency: Excellent understanding of design patterns and architectural best practices for building scalable and maintainable mobile applications
Cross-Platform Mobile Expertise: Experience with cross-platform mobile development approaches (shared architecture, common patterns) and platform-specific considerations
API and Integration Expertise: Strong understanding of API design and integration principles, with a focus on creating seamless and efficient integration experiences for mobile app developers
Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentor other mobile engineers, and drive technical direction
Communication and Collaboration: Exceptional communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
Problem-Solving and Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to identify and resolve complex mobile technical challenges
Quality Focus: A commitment to delivering high-quality, well-tested, and performant mobile solutions
Bonus Points
• Experience with geolocation technologies and compliance solutions
• Experience with desktop application development (C++)
• Experience with front-end web development (JavaScript, modern frameworks)
• Experience with React Native, Flutter, or other cross-platform mobile frameworks
• Contributions to open-source mobile projects
• Experience with mobile CI/CD pipelines and automation
Why You'll Love Working Here
Our Benefits:
• Learning opportunities & personal development allowance
• 20 annual leave days, 5 sick leave days
• Extensive health insurance
• Competitive salary package, 100% salary during the probation period
• Attractive bonuses (13th month, business performance, equity plans)
• Annual salary performance review
• Hybrid working mode & Modern office at a prime location in District 1
• Free parking
• Annual company trip & year-end party
• Quarterly team-building activities
• In-office snacks and drinks
• International working environment
About GeoComply
We’re GeoComply! We are at the forefront of geolocation, cybersecurity, and anti-fraud innovation, developing and delivering cutting-edge technologies to help ensure regulatory compliance, combat bad online actors, alleviate user friction, and protect businesses from fraud.
Achieving significant business and revenue growth over the past three years and dubbed a tech “Unicorn,” GeoComply has been trusted by leading global brands and regulators for over ten years. Our compliance-grade geolocation technology solutions are installed on over 400 million devices and analyze over 12 billion transactions a year.
At the heart of it all is the people, united by a deep commitment to problem-solving and revolutionizing how people and businesses use the internet to instill confidence in every online interaction. With teams across five countries, three continents, and a global customer base, we have no plans to slow down.
Now What? Send us your resume and a cover letter. We Can’t-Wait To Meet You.

Offspring is a boutique digital production studio, founded by an Australian Technical Director, that works with Australian and US markets. We believe that having the best people is more important than having hundreds of people. We believe that work should be about culture, growth and passion… not only money. We believe in pushing people to learn and achieve more. We believe in rewarding people based on their contributions, not who they know. If your values match with ours, then we want to talk to you. Đôi nét về Offspring Offspring Digital là công ty công nghệ của Úc, đã hoạt động ở Hà Nội, Việt Nam gần 10 năm. Hiện công ty có hai đối tượng khách hàng chính: Úc và Mỹ. Về mặt sản phẩm, công ty hiện xây dựng và vận hành các nền tảng social network, thương mại điện tử, ứng dụng liên quan đến sức khỏe trên cả môi trường web và mobile. TIÊU ĐỀ: Applied AI Engineer
CÔNG TY: Everfit
ĐỊA ĐIỂM: Quận Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng

KỸ NĂNG: LLM Agents, LLM / GenAI, LangChain / LangGraph / ADK, RAG, Milvus / pgvector, FastAPI / Flask / Django, Python, JavaScript

--- MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC ---
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us
AI-first company shaping the future of fitness
Join a passionate global team across VN, US, & UK
Collaborative team valuing joy & creativity
The Job
About Everfit
Everfit is one of the fastest growing fitness coaching platforms in the world. We power more than 320,000 coaches across the globe with an all-in-one AI-powered platform to run and grow their businesses. In 6 years, we have become one of the leaders of the health and wellness B2B SaaS category in the US and around the world! We are at an inflection point. We are focusing our efforts to capture more of the $5.1 trillion health and fitness market by going direct to consumers. Our vision is to become the operating system for personal health, where anyone can plug in a coach, or multiple coaches, to reach their wellness goals faster, optimize their human potential, and extend their longevity.
Our team spans from San Francisco to Vietnam, with senior leaders who have built and scaled products at Netflix, Apple, Meta, Nike, Hulu, Uber, Amazon, Hypebeast, and Quibi. We are building the next unicorn to come out of Vietnam, and we are looking for a confident leader who can help us get there.
Position Overview:
As an Applied AI Engineer at Everfit, you'll work at the intersection of backend engineering and applied AI, building the scalable systems and AI-powered experiences that shape the future of fitness coaching for coaches and their clients around the world.
This is not a Backend role with AI sprinkled on top. Expect roughly 70% of your work on LLM-powered systems (agent workflows, RAG, tool calling, evals) and 30% on the core backend services that power them.
Your impact:
What you'll build
• Durable, long-running AI workflows on Temporal: scheduled jobs and multi-step agent processes that survive restarts, retries, and partial failures.
• Reliable AI pipelines with validation, retries, fallbacks, guardrails, and observability.
• Systems designed around AI-specific constraints: latency, token cost, model failures, quality.
• Production integrations with OpenAI and Anthropic models.
• The path from experiment to production: take a validated AI capability from the AI team and ship it as a service with clear reliability, cost, and quality characteristics.
• Evals and monitoring that define how AI features are measured, and catch regressions before users do.
How you'll work
• Scalable backend services in Node.js/TypeScript, with system architecture, technical design, and code review across Everfit's backend.
• Rapid experiments with emerging AI tech, turning the successful ones into production solutions.
• Day-to-day with Product Managers, AI Engineers, and QA, from technical discovery through delivery.
• Investigating production issues and improving AI workflows from real user feedback.
• Helping the broader engineering org adopt AI-native development practices.
Your Skills and Experience
• 4+ years of professional backend engineering experience.
• Comfortable communicating in English and working with an international team.
• Strong programming experience (preferably Node.js / TypeScript / Python) and backend architecture. Our core backend is Node.js/TypeScript and our AI services are Python/FastAPI; you'll work mainly in Node but should be comfortable crossing into Python when the work lives there.
• Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, databases, and scalable system design.
• Strong experience with databases such as MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
• You have shipped at least one LLM-powered feature to production for real users, working directly with OpenAI or Anthropic APIs, and can talk concretely about its failure modes, evals, latency, and cost.
• You already use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex) daily, and you review what they produce with judgment about architecture, security, and edge cases.
• Comfortable experimenting with new AI tools and technologies and turning successful experiments into production solutions.
• Curious, proactive, and excited about how AI can fundamentally change software development and product experiences.
[Nice to have]
• Experience with Python / FastAPI or AI-focused backend development.
• Experience building production LLM features, RAG pipelines, or agentic systems.
• Familiarity with the stack we run in production: Pydantic/LangGraph, Qdrant for vector search, Langfuse for LLM observability, and MCP.
• Experience with AWS, Docker, message queues, or cloud-native architecture.
• Experience improving engineering productivity through AI, with measurable impact.
• Experience working with health, fitness, wellness, personalization, or recommendation systems.
• Open-source contributions or personal projects involving AI.
Why You'll Love Working Here
Compensation & Benefits:
• Full social insurance coverage and premium healthcare benefits.
• Competitive salary with 13th-month pay and performance bonus.
• Paid leave — vacation, sick leave, and maternity leave
Build Your Career with Impact:
• Be part of a mission-driven company that’s transforming human potential.
• Empower over 300,000+ coaches in more than 200 countries - including Olympic athletes, military trainers, rehab specialists, and celebrity coaches.
• Make a global impact while building a meaningful, purpose-driven career.
• Continuous training, mentoring.
• 1-2 performance reviews annually.
Work Environment:
• English-speaking, international environment promoting open communication and collaboration.
• Work alongside world-class talent from companies like Apple, Meta, Uber, Patreon, and Nike, united by a shared passion for impact and excellence.
• International team for global career growth.
• State-of-the-art equipment provided.
• Beautiful working environment near Danang's city center (Dragon Bridge) and Hanoi office.
Health & Wellness:
• PVI health insurance program and annual health check-ups.
• Active sports clubs (football, badminton, pickleball) and company retreats.
• A modern pantry designed for relaxation and social connection.
• Monthly wellness and learning workshops to recharge and grow.

AI-first company shaping the future of fitness
Join a passionate global team across VN, US, & UK

The Job
About Everfit
Everfit is one of the fastest growing fitness coaching platforms in the world. We power more than 320,000 coaches across the globe with an all-in-one AI-powered platform to run and grow their businesses. In 6 years, we have become one of the leaders of the health and wellness B2B SaaS category in the US and around the world! We are at an inflection point. We are focusing our efforts to capture more of the $5.1 trillion health and fitness market by going direct to consumers. Our vision is to become the operating system for personal health, where anyone can plug in a coach, or multiple coaches, to reach their wellness goals faster, optimize their human potential, and extend their longevity.
Our team spans from San Francisco to Vietnam, with senior leaders who have built and scaled products at Netflix, Apple, Meta, Nike, Hulu, Uber, Amazon, Hypebeast, and Quibi. We are building the next unicorn to come out of Vietnam, and we are looking for a confident leader who can help us get there.
Position Overview:
You will train and adapt models using Everfit’s product data and feedback, then take them into production. You will own the technical work from problem definition and data preparation through training, evaluation, release, and monitoring.
Some problems call for a small classifier or ranking model. Others may benefit from adapting a pretrained language or vision model. You will assess where training can improve quality, personalization, speed, or cost, recommend an approach, and test it against the current product.
You will work with Applied AI Engineers, Backend Engineers, Data Engineers, and product partners. Your focus will be training data, learned representations, model adaptation, evaluation, and the model lifecycle. Applied AI colleagues contribute the surrounding context, tools, and application workflows. Together, you will make sure model improvements reach users and solve the intended problem.
Your impact:
Choose the problem and approach
• Work with product and domain partners to define the user problem, the decision a model should support, and how to measure a better result.
• Investigate whether errors come from the model, labels, missing context, reference data, or product integration.
• Compare the current workflow with simple baselines, existing models, and training-based approaches. Recommend the approach the evidence supports.
Build data that supports learning
• Work with data engineers and domain experts to prepare training and evaluation datasets. Define labels, review disagreements, and check missing records, duplicates, and uneven coverage.
• Turn product feedback into useful training examples. Check that a coach edit, click, purchase, or correction means what the training objective assumes.
• Keep training and evaluation separate. Use time, user, coach, or workspace boundaries where needed, and prevent future information from entering earlier examples.
• Test unfamiliar users and items, sparse histories, and important failure cases. Distinguish missing activity records from inactivity when working with engagement data.
Train, adapt, and evaluate models
• Build task-specific models and adapt pretrained models where appropriate. Methods may include supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), distillation, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), including low-rank adaptation (LoRA).
• Choose metrics that match the task. Examine ranking quality, per-category classification errors, language quality, or recognition and portion errors as appropriate.
• Check uncertainty and define when a model should abstain, request more information, or use a fallback. Review the consequences of different mistakes with product partners.
• Version datasets, labels, transformations, model artifacts, and evaluation settings so another engineer can reproduce the result.
Deliver and improve the product
• Work with backend, data, and DevOps colleagues to deploy and serve models in batch or online services. Keep training and serving transformations consistent and test the full path to the result users receive.
• Compare model quality with response time, memory use, and operating cost. Diagnose failures and make improvements without hiding regressions in an average score.
• Run controlled product experiments with the team. Measure useful outcomes alongside offline scores, and document what the evidence supports.
• Monitor model and data performance after release. Validate updates before deployment, maintain a rollback path, and turn confirmed failures into regression tests.
• Protect coach and client data in datasets, inference, and logs. Follow workspace access boundaries and approved retention and deletion rules.
Your Skills and Experience
• Good English communication - Clear communication about technical choices and limitations.
• 5+ years of relevant experience in Machine Learning / Applied ML / ML Engineering, with strong hands-on experience building and deploying ML models to production.
• Strong Python and practical SQL skills.
• Strong foundations in probability, statistics, and machine learning. You can apply regularization, recognize overfitting and sampling bias, and explain how training objectives affect model behavior.
• Experience building and tuning conventional ML models, such as linear or tree-based models, and comparing them with neural or pretrained approaches. You can explain why the complexity of a model is justified.
• Experience preparing training data and developing features or embeddings, including work with missing values, imbalanced labels, noisy feedback, and limited examples.
• Experience fine-tuning Transformer models (e.g., via Hugging Face) for downstream tasks and domain-specific datasets.
• Experience choosing baselines, validation splits, and task-appropriate metrics; preventing data leakage; and analyzing errors across important user groups and cases. You can assess whether an improvement is meaningful for the product.
• Experience training or adapting models with tools such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn, taking them into production, and measuring their performance after release. You can explain the decisions you owned, the failures you investigated, and the results.
• Strong practical depth in at least one relevant area: recommendation and ranking, classification, natural-language processing and language-model adaptation, or computer vision and multimodal learning.
• Experience with reproducible training pipelines, experiment tracking, dataset and model versioning, and containerized deployment using Docker or equivalent tools. You can work with automated testing and release workflows.
• Good software engineering habits, including version control, readable code, tests, and documentation.
• Turn ambiguous product problems into practical experiments, define data and evaluation requirements, and make evidence-based decisions about deployment.
• Own model quality and production performance, balancing quality, latency, cost, and maintainability while driving follow-up improvements.
• Review technical work, mentor earlier-career engineers, and lead the investigation and resolution of model or data failures in your area.
[Nice to have]
• Multi-label classification, image segmentation, pose estimation, or learning from time-series data.
• Efficient inference, model compression, or cloud-based training and deployment on platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure.
• Designing human evaluation and annotation workflows for subjective or ambiguous labels.
• Health, fitness, nutrition, wearable, or other longitudinal user data.
• Using AI coding tools effectively and checking their output.
• Relevant research or open-source contributions.
Why You'll Love Working Here
Compensation & Benefits:
• Full social insurance coverage and premium healthcare benefits.
• Competitive salary with 13th-month pay and performance bonus.
• Paid leave — vacation, sick leave, and maternity leave
Build Your Career with Impact:
• Be part of a mission-driven company that’s transforming human potential.
• Empower over 300,000+ coaches in more than 200 countries - including Olympic athletes, military trainers, rehab specialists, and celebrity coaches.
• Make a global impact while building a meaningful, purpose-driven career.
• Continuous training, mentoring.
• 1-2 performance reviews annually.
Work Environment:
• English-speaking, international environment promoting open communication and collaboration.
• Work alongside world-class talent from companies like Apple, Meta, Uber, Patreon, and Nike, united by a shared passion for impact and excellence.
• International team for global career growth.
• State-of-the-art equipment provided.
• Beautiful working environment near Danang's city center (Dragon Bridge) and Hanoi office.
Health & Wellness:
• PVI health insurance program and annual health check-ups.
• Active sports clubs (football, badminton, pickleball) and company retreats.
• A modern pantry designed for relaxation and social connection.
• Monthly wellness and learning workshops to recharge and grow.

The Job
We are seeking an AI QA & Data Quality Specialist to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of AI-driven products and the data pipelines that support them. This role focuses on validating AI model outputs, testing AI-powered features, and ensuring the integrity and quality of datasets and data pipelines used for training and inference.
You will work closely with engineering, data engineering, and product teams to improve the overall quality of AI systems through systematic testing, data validation, and automation.
This role expects a strong security mindset, with a clear understanding of data privacy, credential protection, device security, and the responsible use of corporate systems, tools, and accounts.
Key Responsibilities
AI System Quality Assurance
• Design and execute test strategies for AI/ML-powered applications and features.
• Validate AI model outputs for accuracy, reliability, and consistency.
• Perform prompt testing, response evaluation, and edge case validation for AI systems.
• Identify issues such as hallucinations, bias, incorrect reasoning, or unstable responses
• Define acceptance criteria and quality benchmarks for AI-driven features.
Data Engineering & Data Pipeline Testing
• Validate data pipelines (ETL/ELT) used to prepare datasets for AI models.
• Test data ingestion, transformation, and loading processes to ensure reliability.
• Verify data integrity between source systems, data warehouses, and AI models.
• Detects and reports data anomalies, schema changes, missing data, or transformation errors.
• Create data validation rules and automated data quality checks.
Dataset & Model Evaluation

Function/Department description
The Research and Development (R&D) Department is responsible for innovating and optimizing processes to improve productivity and efficiency while reducing costs. This includes developing new procedures, enhancing current processes, managing and visualizing data using tools like Power BI, and addressing raw material issues by developing supplier areas and ensuring the quality of raw materials.
Purpose of the position
The Senior Process R&D Optimization Executive is responsible for implementing improvement projects in the factory and optimizing equipment processes. This role includes performing detailed calculations and simulations before implementation, continuously updating new technology solutions and applying them in the factory, collaborating with the team to improve processes, and supporting the factory team as needed.
Main Responsibilities:
The Senior Process R&D Optimization Executive responsibilities are to:
1. Business Intelligence System Development & Technical Evaluation
•                  Manage and develop the Business Intelligence (BI) system to support analytics and business decision-making.
•                  Build and maintain dashboards and data pipelines integrating sources such as ERP, IoT, and SCADA.
•                  Evaluate and optimize data infrastructure to ensure stability, scalability, and performance.
•                  Conduct data modeling, simulations, and technical feasibility assessments for new solutions.
2.              Data System Optimization & Continuous Innovation
•                  Develop and enhance the company’s data ecosystem through new technologies such as Microsoft Fabric and AI analytics.
•                  Integrate and leverage IoT, SCADA, and other data systems to support process optimization and digital transformation.
•                  Lead BI improvement and innovation projects following Lean/IWS methodologies.
•                  Research, update, and implement emerging data technologies to improve efficiency and business insights.
3.              Cross-functional Collaboration & Knowledge Transfer
•                  Cross-functional collaboration: Provide technical advice and guidance on implementing process changes to the factory team as needed.
•                  Problem-solving: Analyse and resolve issues related to production processes and equipment, work closely with stakeholders for solving problems that arise at the site.
•                  Conduct on-the-job training, cross-training or coaching to the production team on processes, equipment and troubleshooting methods.
4.              Compliance & Reporting
•                  Ensure compliance: Ensure that processes and equipment comply with regulations and quality standards.
•                  Report and track progress: Report progress and results of improvement projects to the Process R&D Optimization Manager and monitor and assess the effectiveness of implemented improvements. Perform various other duties and activities as assigned by the manager.
5.              Perform other duties and tasks as assigned by the Process R&D Optimization Manager to support the overall improvement and operational efficiency of the factory.

Minimum 1–2 years of experience in production/process engineering, continuous improvement, or technical support roles in manufacturing

--- MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC ---
About Phuc Sinh Corporation
Phuc Sinh Corporation is one of Vietnam's leading exporters of premium agricultural commodities — including pepper, coffee, cashew nuts, cassia, star anise, chili, and desiccated coconut — with over 20 years of experience supplying global markets across Europe, the USA, Asia, and beyond. With a strong commitment to quality (BRC, HACCP, ISO 9001:2015 certified) and sustainability (Rainforest Alliance), we are a fast-growing corporation with multiple subsidiaries and factories across Vietnam. Our team is the backbone of everything we do, and we invest in people who are motivated, sharp, and ready to grow with us.
Role Overview
We are looking for a skilled Developer to join our IT team, responsible for building and maintaining web and application systems — including our in-house ERP system — for Phuc Sinh Corporation and its subsidiaries. You will work closely with the Business Analyst and Infrastructure team to deliver reliable, well-designed software solutions that support business operations across the group.
Key Responsibilities
Software Development
- Design, develop, test, and deploy web and application features for the Company's in-house ERP system and other internal systems.
- Build and maintain software solutions used by Phuc Sinh Corporation and its subsidiaries, including the FMCG company.
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
- Participate in code reviews and follow the Company's development standards.
Maintenance & Support
- Maintain and troubleshoot existing systems; fix bugs and resolve issues reported by users.
- Monitor system performance and proactively identify areas for improvement.
- Provide technical support to end users across subsidiaries when needed.
Collaboration
- Work closely with the Business Analyst to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
- Coordinate with the Infrastructure team on deployment, hosting, and system integration matters.
- Participate in project planning and provide input on technical feasibility and timelines.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Về Tập đoàn Phúc Sinh
Phúc Sinh là một trong những doanh nghiệp xuất khẩu nông sản hàng đầu Việt Nam, với danh mục sản phẩm đa dạng gồm tiêu, cà phê, hạt điều, quế, hồi, ớt và dừa sấy. Với hơn 20 năm kinh nghiệm cung cấp cho các thị trường quốc tế tại châu Âu, Mỹ, châu Á và nhiều khu vực khác, chúng tôi tự hào là đối tác đáng tin cậy của các khách hàng khắt khe nhất trên toàn cầu. Phúc Sinh cam kết mạnh mẽ với chất lượng sản phẩm (đạt chứng nhận BRC, HACCP, ISO 9001:2015) và phát triển bền vững (Rainforest Alliance). Chúng tôi đang không ngừng mở rộng với nhiều công ty thành viên và nhà máy trên cả nước — và đội ngũ con người chính là nền tảng của sự phát triển đó.

Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm một Lập trình viên (Developer) gia nhập đội ngũ CNTT, chịu trách nhiệm xây dựng và bảo trì các hệ thống web và ứng dụng — bao gồm hệ thống ERP nội bộ — cho Tập đoàn Phúc Sinh và các công ty thành viên. Bạn sẽ phối hợp chặt chẽ với Chuyên viên Phân tích nghiệp vụ và bộ phận Hạ tầng để triển khai các giải pháp phần mềm đáng tin cậy, được thiết kế tốt, phục vụ hoạt động kinh doanh trên toàn Tập đoàn.

- Xây dựng và bảo trì các giải pháp phần mềm được sử dụng bởi Tập đoàn Phúc Sinh và các công ty thành viên, bao gồm công ty FMCG.
- Viết code rõ ràng, dễ bảo trì và có tài liệu đầy đủ.
- Tham gia review code và tuân thủ các tiêu chuẩn phát triển của Công ty.
Bảo trì và hỗ trợ
- Bảo trì, xử lý sự cố hệ thống hiện có; sửa lỗi và giải quyết các vấn đề người dùng phản ánh.

Qualifications
·       Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
·       Minimum 2-4 years of hands-on experience as a developer, building web and/or application software.
·       Proficient in at least one backend stack (.NET, Java, PHP, or equivalent) combined with a modern frontend framework.

·       AI-First Mindset: able to leverage AI-assisted tools intelligently and efficiently throughout the development workflow, with a clear understanding of how to review and control the quality of AI-generated code.
·       Strong problem-solving ability; capable of working both independently and collaboratively within a team.
·       English proficiency at an intermediate level or above, sufficient to read technical documentation.
·       Candidates with prior experience building or implementing modules within an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system are preferred.
·       Candidates with experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment are preferred.[THD1]

- A dynamic, international working environment with real ownership and meaningful career progression

The Job
Job description
We are looking for Middle/Senior Software Developers to join the Core Banking team at Shinhan Bank Vietnam. The candidate will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and enhancing Core Banking applications and related banking systems, ensuring system stability, performance, and compliance with banking regulations.
The role will collaborate closely with business teams and project members to support loan banking modules and card-related services.
2. Key Responsibilities
Core Banking Development
• Maintain and enhance backend services of the Core Banking System.
• Analyze and resolve bugs, incidents, and performance issues in production and non-production environments.
• Perform database query tuning and optimize system performance.
• Write and maintain technical documentation (design documents, API specifications, release notes).
• Participate in code reviews and ensure development standards are followed.
• Collaborate with business and technical teams to deliver stable and secure solutions.
• Submit progress reports and support issue tracking activities.
• Comply with security policies and change management procedures.
Depending on project assignments, candidates may work on Core Banking modules related to Loan Banking Services or Card Systems.
Banking Business Development (Loan Modules)
• Design and develop end-to-end lending systems
• Implement credit scoring, rating models, and limit management
• Digitalize lending workflows (application, underwriting, approval hierarchy)
• Manage loan lifecycle (interest, schedules, overdue, restructuring)
• Develop loan products (term loan, revolving, credit line)
• Ensure compliance with credit policies and regulations
Card System Development
• Develop and maintain card-related services and transaction systems.
• Handle card lifecycle management:
• Issuance
• Activation
• Debit/Credit processing
• Support transaction processing:
• Clearing
• Settlement
• Reconciliation
• Ensure compliance with banking regulations and international standards such as PCI DSS and ISO 8583.
Your Skills and Experience
Technical Requirements
• Experience in developing main services using C-based frameworks
• Proficiency in building terminal/screen interfaces with HTML5, CSS, JavaScript
• Strong knowledge of database design and management using Oracle SQL/PLSQL
• Experience working in Linux/Unix-based operating environments
• Ability to ensure system performance, stability, and scalability.
4. Soft Skills
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks.
• Proactive, responsible, and detail-oriented mindset.
• Good written communication skills in English.
5. General Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
• 5+ years of relevant experience (senior level).
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks.
• Experience in financial services or banking IT systems.
• Knowledge of banking protocols (ISO 8583, SWIFT, etc.).
• Familiarity with Napas 247, eWallet, and SBV reporting.
• Knowledge of security standards and compliance requirements.
Why You'll Love Working Here
• Pass-Probation Bonus
• 13th month Salary
• Performance Bonus
• Friend Referral Program Bonus and many other incentives.
• 12 days of Annual leaves + 3 Sickness leaves
• Personal Allowances for birthdays, marriage, new babies, etc.
• Team monthly allowance.
• Special loan offers and fee waivers from Shinhan Bank.
• Company Trips, annual/monthly/weekly activities, and events.
• Health checks once a year and a premium healthcare program.
• Education Programs and overseas training opportunities.
• Your solutions and opinions are welcomed.

--- THÔNG TIN KHÁC ---

Top 3 Reasons To Join Us
18+ days of annual leave
Premium health insurance
13th month salary
The Job
Prefer immediate employment / ƯU TIÊN ĐI LÀM NGAY
Your main activities
• Develop back-end APIs using Java (Spring Boot) and/or Go — both are used across our new projects.
• Design and work with relational databases (PostgreSQL) — schema, migrations, queries.
• Integrate with third-party service providers over REST and SOAP, and make those integrations resilient when the provider is slow or down.
• Work with Kafka for asynchronous processing and event-driven flows.
• Develop user interfaces in JavaScript / TypeScript / HTML5 / CSS3 using Angular or ReactJS, responsive on desktop and mobile browsers.
• Consume your own APIs from the client, including streaming responses where results arrive progressively rather than all at once.
• Work with shared packages in a monorepo — shared business logic, generated API clients and a design system.
• Test, commit and integrate your code with our online products.
• Work as part of an AI agent team — set up and run AI agents that implement, review and verify work under your direction.
Your Skills and Experience
Your Skills and Experience
You do not need to be equally strong on both sides. You do need to be genuinely productive on both — able to take a feature from the database to the screen without handing it over halfway.
Back-end
• Experienced with Java (Spring Boot, Java 17+) and/or Go. Strong in one and willing to work in the other is fine; strong in both is better.
• Solid understanding of REST API design, and of documenting an API as a contract (OpenAPI).
• Working knowledge of relational databases — transactions, indexing, and why a query is slow.
• Experience integrating third-party APIs: timeouts, retries, and knowing which operations are safe to retry and which are not.
Front-end
• Experienced with Angular or ReactJS and TypeScript. Being able to work in both is a big plus — we run both, and people who move between them are the ones who see the pattern instead of the framework.
• Experience with micro-frontends — module boundaries, independent deployment, and the versioning and caching problems that come with them.
• Solid HTML5 / CSS3 and responsive layout skills.
• Experience handling server state properly (TanStack Query, SWR, RxJS or similar) — not everything in a global store.
• Experience building forms and data tables at real complexity — validation, server-side errors, multi-step flows.
• Awareness of accessibility and keyboard interaction as a default, not a retrofit.
• A product mindset about UI/UX. You care how the screen actually feels to use, and when a design or a requirement looks wrong you say so instead of building it silently. We would rather have the argument before the sprint than the rework after it.
General
• Comfortable with automated testing on both sides as part of your normal workflow, not as a separate phase.
• Strong interest in software design, programming and testing.
• Prefer immediate employment.
Working with AI — required, not optional
• Proficient, hands-on experience with AI coding agents in daily development work.
• Able to set up an AI agent team — define agent roles, skills and gates so a feature can be split across several agents and still come back consistent.
• Proficient in prompt engineering — you can turn a vague requirement into instructions an agent executes reliably, and keep it on the project's conventions.
• Experience setting up an agent harness: project-level instruction files, custom commands and skills, sub-agents with scoped tools and permissions, hooks for the rules that must always hold.
• Loop engineering — you build an objective verifier and let the agent iterate against it instead of reviewing output by eye. On the back end that means unit tests, type checks and architecture or lint gates; turning a rule you would otherwise repeat in code review into an automated check is the core skill. On the front end it means more than "it compiles" — you also give the agent a way to observe the rendered result (for example a browser-automation screenshot or an accessibility snapshot). Candidates who have closed that visual loop are rare and we want them.
• Experience setting up AI code review — automated review in the pull-request flow, tuned so it catches real defects instead of producing noise everyone learns to ignore.
• Experience building an autonomous agent team — agents that plan, implement, review and verify, with a human at the gates — is a strong advantage.
• Critical evaluation of AI output. You can spot a diff that looks correct and quietly breaks a business rule, and a component that renders fine in the demo and falls apart on real data or a slow network.
• You are empowered by AI — and you are accountable for everything it produces on your behalf. This is the single most important expectation of the role. We want you to lean on AI heavily; "the AI wrote it" is never an explanation for a defect that reached production.
Nice to have
• Experienced with DevOps activities is a remarkable plus — reading and writing Kubernetes manifests, building your own service's CI pipeline, and debugging your service from outside (logs, metrics, traces) rather than waiting for the platform team.
• Experience with penetration testing and security best practices is a big plus — OWASP Top 10, authorization checks that hold when an identifier comes from outside, secret handling, and remediating a real finding rather than reading about one.
• Experienced with Linux.
• Experience with Keycloak / OAuth2, or Redis.
• Experience with React Native — some of our shared business logic is used by mobile apps too.
• Experience with Tailwind, Radix, or building a design system with multi-brand tokens.
• Experience with end-to-end testing (Playwright or Cypress).
• Experience in travel, e-commerce, fintech or any domain with money and third-party providers involved.
• Graduated in Vietnam National University, Ho Chi Minh City is a big plus.
